customer.line_binding_hint: To bind LINE after creating the customer, go to that customer's edit page and use the "LINE binding" section to generate a binding code. There is intentionally no LINE User ID field here: customers cannot see their own LINE User ID, manual entry is error-prone, and a wrong value gives no error — notifications silently fail to arrive. For Telegram, customers can find their ID via Telegram's userinfobot, so it can be entered directly above.

analytics.trend_note: Based on work order creation date and checked-out work orders; revenue and cost match the exported report. Labor cost (technician commission) is attributed to the labor month, unlike other costs which follow the work order creation month, so gross profit for orders spanning months may not align with that month's revenue.

ap.intro: Purchases create a payable snapshot on goods receipt and subcontracting on creation; payments accumulate via installments, and voiding keeps the original payable record.
ap.aging_note: Calculated by due date; not-yet-due items fall into 0-30 days. Items without a due date use the payable creation date. Totals are unpaid balances.

mainttpl.title: Maintenance Plans
mainttpl.intro: Migrated from the legacy "Maintenance Records" table. When creating a work order, standard items can be applied by mileage tier instead of adding them manually each time. Item definitions come from the legacy system; prices are mostly 0 (not filled in back then).
mainttpl.field.name: Plan Name
mainttpl.code_ph: e.g. LOCAL-5K (cannot be changed after creation)
mainttpl.new_hint: After creation, add standard items (part no., name, quantity, unit price) on the edit page. The code cannot be changed after creation because legacy work orders may reference the same numbering.
mainttpl.items_hint: Saving replaces all existing items with the content here. Blank rows are ignored; deleting all rows means this plan has no standard items.
